title: ShardConfig
description: The per-shard keys the colo compose reads from shards/<name>.yaml (Phase 1, wave C1). Declared here; no value is set by the contract. Unknown keys are an error. The Phase 0 shard file has none of these keys yet.

cpu_limit.description: CPU limit for the shard container, in cores. Greater than 0 and at most 64.

memory_limit.description: Memory limit for the shard container, Docker form: a whole number of m or g, from 10m to 99999g.

minecraft_port.description: Host port for the Minecraft listener. 25566 is reserved and rejected.

bind_address.description: Host address the listener binds to. Loopback by default.

telemetry_url.description: Optional telemetry endpoint. No default: unset means no telemetry.
